Call Appearance Functions

Conferencing a Call

This section describes the functions you can use to set up a conference call and split conference members from a conference call. To set up a conference call, you call the TELConferencePrep function to place a call to a new party, then call the TELConferenceEstablish function to add that party to a conference call. To split conference members from a conference call, you call the TELConferenceSplit function.
